# AfterSlim

> AfterSlim is a US-market dietary supplement designed as a daily companion for women on a weight loss journey, especially those taking GLP-1 medications (Mounjaro, Ozempic, Wegovy). The 5-in-1 capsule supports hair, energy, gut health, satiety, and nutritional recovery during rapid weight loss.

## Product

- [AfterSlim GLP-1 Balance](https://www.afterslim.com/): Main product page with full ingredient list, benefits, FAQ, and bundle pricing (1, 2, or 3 bottles).
- [Checkout](https://www.afterslim.com/checkout): Secure checkout with Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal.

## Key facts

- Form: dietary supplement capsule
- Dose: 1 capsule daily, taken with a meal
- Bottle size: 30 capsules (1-month supply)
- Bundle options: 1 bottle, 2 bottles (recommended), 3 bottles (best value)
- Made in the United States with globally sourced ingredients
- Manufacturer: VQ Group LLC, Winter Garden, Florida, USA
- Trademark: AFTERSLIM, USPTO Serial 99691837 (filed March 9, 2026)

## Audience and positioning

- Primary audience: women, ages 30-55, in the United States
- Positioning: GLP-1 companion supplement — supports nutrition gaps that often occur during rapid weight loss on Mounjaro, Ozempic, or Wegovy
- Brand voice: warm, scientific, aspirational — not clinical, not pushy

## What AfterSlim supports

1. Hair health during rapid weight loss
2. Steady daily energy
3. Gut microbiome health
4. Satiety and mindful eating
5. Nutritional recovery from restrictive eating patterns

## Compliance

These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Always consult your healthcare provider before starting a new supplement, especially if you are taking prescription medications.
